statement: The University of Florida blueberry breeding programme publishes measured values for Meadowlark 'FL01-173' of firmness of 221 to 277 g/mm with an average of 256, average berry weight of 2.5 g, average diameter of 18.3 mm and average soluble solids of 10.9 degrees Brix. The firmness figures use the programme's own g/mm compression index and are not directly comparable with firmness figures produced by other methods.
